_comment: Refill for the 0.6 m pair13 main sweep: 6 blocks gave up at 12 degrees per side on 6 October (sensor A ambient drift, same signature as the 0.9 m gaps): d060_t120_r3_roi16, r4, r5 and d060_t120_r3_roi4, r4, r5. Repeats 1 and 2 at 12 degrees already exist and passed, so this regenerates all 5 repeats for roi16 and roi4 at this one angle; keep repeats 3-5 from this run when merging and discard 1-2 as redundant. Same calibration as rq3_jessica_0p6.json. If sensor A's ambient starts drifting again, wait a few minutes for it to settle before retrying. Run: python -m rig session --guided --port COM7 --config configs/rq3_jessica_0p6_refill_t12.json --out data --tag refill
